title: Semantic zdump-witness report (zic-rs-semantic-report-v1)
description: zdump-backed offset/is_dst/abbreviation witnesses over a declared horizon, with oracle_identity and oracle_mode (absence visible). Published contract scope: this pins the schema **identity** (the `schema` const) and the top-level object shape. Field-level tightening and full instance-validation against a JSON-Schema validator are a tracked audit-suite item (the core crate carries no validator dependency); see docs/schema-compatibility-policy.md for the versioning rules and tests/schemas.rs for the registry/drift guard.

schema.description: the immutable schema identity; bumped only on a meaning change
